model: FR-F800 inverter (BACnet MS/TP; FR-F800-E BACnet IP)
equipment_type: Variable frequency drive (HVAC fan and pump)
applies_to: Mitsubishi Electric FR-F800 fan and pump inverters (FR-F820/F840/F842/F846) on the RS-485 terminals, and FR-F800-E models on the built-in Ethernet port.
summary: The FR-F800 runs BACnet MS/TP on its RS-485 terminals when Pr.549 = 2; the FR-F800-E Ethernet models also offer BACnet IP. Both manuals print the same fixed object list: terminal inputs and outputs, run/stop, direction and fault reset BVs, the Speed scale frequency command (% of Pr.390), PID setpoint and feedback commands, output monitors, fault history and a mailbox for other parameters. The drive is a B-ASC.
firmware: PICS firmware revision 2.00 (MS/TP manual); 1.00 in the Ethernet manual PICS
notes: Points are from the FR-F800 Instruction Manual (Detailed) IB-0600547ENG-G, section 5.12.7 (PDF pp546-550). The FR-A800-E/F800-E Ethernet Function Manual IB-0600628ENG-D (PDF pp85-88) lists the same objects, names and units for BACnet IP; that manual says only FR-F800-E drives support BACnet IP.
The Ethernet manual marks BO 1-6 as R and BV 300-306 as R or blank; the MS/TP manual marks them all C. The MS/TP manual values are used here.
BO 0-6 only drive their terminals when that terminal's function (Pr.190-Pr.196) is 82 or 182.
BV 305 JOG, BV 307 STOP, BV 308 RES and BV 309 CS have no effect at the factory setting; reassign those signals with Pr.185, Pr.186, Pr.188 and Pr.189 to use them.
AV 398/399 mailbox: write a register number to AV 398, then read or write AV 399. Register numbers follow the manual (for example 41000 + parameter number for Pr.0-999).
Writes to C objects stay in the priority array even when the drive refuses them (Write Access Denied) because of the operation mode.

source.title: FR-F800 Instruction Manual (Detailed), 5.12.7 BACnet MS/TP protocol, Supported BACnet object; also FR-A800-E/FR-F800-E Ethernet Function Manual, 2.5.7 BACnet/IP

integration.summary: For MS/TP set Pr.549 = 2, the MAC address in Pr.331, the baud rate in Pr.332 and the device instance in Pr.728/Pr.729. For BACnet IP on an F800-E set 47808 in one of Pr.1427-Pr.1429 and allow the BMS IP range in Pr.1449-Pr.1454. With the drive in Network operation mode and NET as command and speed source, write AV 300 Speed scale and BV 400 Run/Stop, and read BV 0, AV 1, AV 2 and BV 99.
integration.enable: BV 400/401 and the AV 300-322 commands can be written at any time but are only applied when the communication operation command source and speed command source are NET (Pr.338/Pr.339) and the drive is in Network operation mode. The start command takes effect after Speed scale is applied.
integration.heartbeat: The MS/TP section gives no BACnet-specific timeout. For RS-485 terminal communication, Pr.502 sets the action on a communication error (coast, decelerate to stop, or keep running at the Pr.779 frequency) and the LF alarm turns on. On an F800-E, Pr.1432 Ethernet communication check time interval (default 9999 = off) trips E.EHR if the devices in the Pr.1449-Pr.1454 range stop sending; Pr.1431 sets the action on a physical Ethernet loss.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 311 PID measured value CMD lets the BMS write the PID feedback (and AV 310 the setpoint) when Pr.128 = 60 or 61; AV 321/AV 320 do the same for the second PID when Pr.753 = 60 or 61.
setup: MS/TP: Pr.549 = 2 (BACnet MS/TP), Pr.331 MAC address 0-127 (default 0), Pr.332 baud rate = setting x 100 bps (96 default, up to 1152).
Pr.726 Auto Baudrate/Max Master: bit 7 turns on auto baud, bits 0-6 are Max Master (default 255). Pr.727 Max Info Frames, default 1.
Device instance = Pr.728 (upper 3 digits) and Pr.729 (lower 4 digits), 0 to 4194302, default 0.
MS/TP is fixed at 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit. The drive has local bias resistors only, so at least one node on the segment must provide network bias.
BACnet IP (FR-F800-E only): set 47808 in one of Pr.1427-Pr.1429 Ethernet function selection and set Pr.1449-Pr.1454 to the BMS IP range; while those are 0, no commands are accepted over Ethernet.
Pr.390 % setting reference frequency (default 60 Hz FM / 50 Hz CA) is the 100 % point for AV 300.
gotchas: Pr.342 = 0 (default) stores parameters written over the network in EEPROM; set Pr.342 = 1 if the BMS writes parameters often.
The set frequency only changes when AV 300 is written, not when Pr.390 changes, and it is held in RAM.
BACnet IP: do not include other inverters' IP addresses in the Pr.1449-Pr.1454 range, or the drive trips E.EHR.
Automatic baud rate recognition writes the detected baud rate to Pr.332 in EEPROM.
